references.text: It was a centre for Ancient Greek democracy, the arts, education and philosophy,[12][13] and was highly influential throughout the Hellenistic world and the European continent, particularly in ancient Rome.[14] For this reason it is often regarded as the cradle of Western civilisation and the birthplace of democracy in its own right independently from the rest of Greece.[15][16]
